member.name: M:SharpEmu.CLI.Program.CheckHostArchitecture
member.summary: The supported host execution model, checked before any emulation starts: the CPU backend executes guest x86-64 code natively, so the host process must be x86-64 — win-x64/linux-x64 on x64 hardware, or osx-x64 under Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon (Rosetta translates the whole process, so it still reports as X64 here). Failing up front on any other process architecture distinguishes that from MoltenVK, signal-handler, or guest-memory startup problems.

member.name: M:SharpEmu.CLI.Program.ConfigureMoltenVkDefaults
member.summary: Applies MoltenVK performance defaults before the Vulkan loader is loaded. Existing user-provided values always take precedence.

member.name: M:SharpEmu.CLI.Program.PreloadMacVulkanLoader
member.summary: Makes a Vulkan loader visible before SDL creates its Vulkan surface. Homebrew's Vulkan libraries are arm64-only and cannot load into this x86-64 (Rosetta 2) process, so a universal libMoltenVK.dylib placed next to the executable (named libvulkan.1.dylib) is preloaded here; dyld can then resolve the loader for SDL and Silk.NET.

member.name: M:SharpEmu.CLI.Program.UseUtf8ConsoleOutput
member.summary: Makes console writes UTF-8 so the GUI's pipe reader (and any modern terminal) decodes non-ASCII text correctly. Without this, redirected output falls back to the OS ANSI code page and characters like "—" arrive mangled.

member.name: M:SharpEmu.CLI.Program.TryGetDebugServerOptions(System.String[],System.Boolean@,SharpEmu.Debugger.Server.DebuggerServerOptions@,System.String@)
member.summary: Detects the --debug-server flag and parses its optional host:port endpoint. Returns false only when the flag is present but its endpoint is malformed, so the caller can abort with a clear error.
